title: Foundation: tokens, brand, pixel assets, shell and frame primitives, i18n, data plumbing, offsets

brief:
You land FIRST and alone. Every parallel track builds on your contracts, so ship exactly the APIs in the spec (sections 2-6, 14, 15). Work on `dev` with small Conventional Commits. Read AGENTS.md first, and read node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/use-link-status.md before writing DockLinks. Keep every file compiling after each commit. The verify gate is `pnpm check` plus `pnpm build`.

COMMIT ORDER

1) feat(theme): yellow default preset, contrast tokens.

title: Site shell: menu bar, popovers, dock, launchpad, footer, auth layout
brief:
Build the public OS shell per spec sections 7, 5 and 13, on top of foundation's primitives (MenuBarShell, Dock, DockLinks, OsClock, OsLights, Window, PixelMark, PixelLogo, PixelIcon, guide-events, AppearanceModeToggle, useMotionPref).

Read AGENTS.md. Also read node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md and the use-link-status doc.

All site-only CSS goes in src/app/styles/site-shell.css inside `@layer components`. Do not edit globals.css or the foundation CSS files. If a shared primitive is wrong, leave a note for qa-docs instead of forking it.

LAYOUT. Rewrite (site)/layout.tsx exactly as in spec 7.1:
- Keep `pickMessages(['common','nav'])`.
- Keep the skip link first.
- Keep main id=main overflow-x-clip inside .os-desktop.
- Keep the GuideMount Suspense that foundation placed, inside .os-desktop after the footer. Do not edit the guide files.
- The dock comes after .os-desktop.
- Popovers (Spotlight, Control Center, Launchpad) are siblings.
- `<Suspense fallback={null}><SiteChrome/></Suspense>`.

MENU BAR (spec 7.2). site-menubar.tsx is a server component that renders MenuBarShell with label=common.menuBar.

title: Home page: ten framed Cloudflare-style sections
brief:
Rebuild the home page per spec section 8 using foundation's frame primitives (FrameSection, FrameGrid, FrameCell, FrameHeaderCell, FrameEyebrow, FrameFiller, framePath), Window, OsLights, the pixel components (PixelLogoCycle, PixelLogoSwap, PixelLogo, PixelMark, PixelIcon, PixelAvatar), the cards' `variant="cell"` (already added by foundation in cards.tsx, which you import but do not edit), brands.ts, brandOf, and the guideAttrs/spotAttrs contract.

Read AGENTS.md (Cache Components rules) first.

RULES
- Every DB-backed part stays an async server component that calls `await connection()` inside its own `<Suspense>`, reusing the existing cached queries. Do not change queries.
- Skeletons render the SAME cells as the real content (Suspense adds no DOM), so CLS is 0.
- The hero `<h1>` is static text and is NEVER opacity-, clip- or transform-animated, and neither is any ancestor.
- Sections 03 onwards wrap their box body in `.frame-cv` (FrameSection cv prop) with the --cis values from the table, and use FrameGrid reveal. Never put cv around sticky content.
- Every section gets `guide={{key, say: t.guide.<key>}}`. Read guide lines from `getMessages(locale).guide` on the server; never ship the namespace. Spots use `spot={{key, say}}`, where say is the visible tagline or an excerpt clamped to 140 chars.
- Section strips: `01 · GOOD-IN-TEAM/~` and so on, built via framePath. Section ids: top, brands, trust, work, services, process, stats, latest, kind-words, contact-cta.
- Fillers complete grids at md and lg (fillerPlan).
- Class maps are literal (Tailwind cannot see interpolated names).

SECTIONS (implement exactly as the spec 8 table):
- 01 hero: the HeroDiagram changes.
  - The hub is PixelLogoCycle play, with literal cell classes 2 at base and 3 at lg, inside a fixed-size hub chip; adjust the connector geometry.
  - Remove violet and the endless dash animation; the packets cap is already set by foundation CSS.
  - The terminal uses OsLights.
  - One radial-gradient glow, with no blur.
  - The diagram is wrapped as a spot (`spot_diagram`) inside `Window path=SYSTEM.APP elevated`.
- 02 brand family: new brand-family.tsx, static.
  - PixelLogoSwap uses literal cells 4, md 6 and lg 8.
  - The :has() swap rules go in home.css, keyed on `.brand-family:has([data-brand=studio]:is(:hover,:focus-within))`.
- 03 trust: the marquee also pauses on :focus-within, and reduced motion wraps it statically.
- 04 work: FeaturedWorkCells with a span-2 large card, then two cells and a view-all cell.
- 05 services: ServicesCells with a brand chip from brandOf(meta), a brand-variant tile and the first 3 highlights, filled to 6.
- 06 process (how-we-work.tsx): keep the radio and :has() zero-JS tabs and the literal tabCls map.
  - Replace MockFrame with Window; the path swaps via a literal map.
  - Tabs become stacked cells, each a spot.
  - The checked tab has an inline-start yellow bar mirrored with --dir.
- 07 stats: 4 cells with tabular-nums.
- 08 latest: two posts plus the course window (Window tone=ink) or post 3 plus a span-2 read-the-blog cell.
- 09 testimonials: a static header, then streamed cells.
- 10 CTA: the yellow px-corners panel with PixelAvatar pose=wave cell=6, static. CtaBand keeps its exported API and props, because site-pages imports it.

CLEANUP: remove the hero and section `-top-16` glow layers, `.bg-grid` and blob usages on home, and violet decorations. Keep sections.tsx exports used elsewhere (CtaBand, ArrowLink re-export). If you rename skeletons, keep CtaBand stable.

I18N: you own site.ts after foundation. The keys from spec 14 already exist. Copy edits are allowed; any new key goes in both fa and en. Keep type_*, level_* and budget_* untouched (used by the panel).

BUDGETS: DOM ≤ 1,800 nodes and ≤ 250 pixel-art SVG elements on `/`. Measure both in the browser console (document.querySelectorAll('*').length; svg.px-art descendants) and record them in the PR.

VERIFY:
- pnpm check, pnpm build.
- `node scripts/shots.mjs / --dark --mobile`, plus /en, with zero errors.
- Check incomplete-row behaviour by temporarily seeding fewer works or services.
- Check RTL: the L-frame at inline-start (right in fa) and the strip lights on the right.
- Under reduced motion: no cycle, no reveal, static marquee.

title: Virtual me: guide layer, lazy engine, narration
brief:
Implement the site guide per spec section 10 (10.1 to 10.5) and the accessibility rules in section 13. The panel guide (10.6) belongs to panel-shell; do not build it.

FILES
- guide-mount.tsx: replace foundation's stub, keeping the same export signature. It is a server component.
  - `await connection()`, then `getPublicProfile()`.
  - Build the greeting with `format(t.guide.greeting, {owner})`, falling back to greetingNoName.
  - Render the 10.2 DOM via guide-layer.tsx: PixelAvatarSprite cell 3, bubble, live region.
  - Pass the labels as props to GuideLoader.
- guide-loader.tsx: client, ≤0.8KB gz.
  - Apply the skip rules and load timing from 10.4.
  - usePathname drives rescan. It is inside GuideMount's Suspense already.
  - Listen for gt:guide and gt:guide-pref (foundation's guide-events.ts).
- guide-engine.ts: vanilla TS, ≤6KB gz, with no React and no imports beyond tiny pure helpers.
- geometry.ts: pure placement functions with full unit tests (LTR, RTL, clamping, bubble flip, gap too small).
- guide.css: all guide styles in @layer components. Include the sprite position vars, arc nesting, trail, bubble with stepped tail, selection box with handles and wiggle, typing dots, wipe (mirrored in RTL), compact mode, hide-while-popover-open via `html:has(:popover-open) .gt-guide{visibility:hidden}`, and reduced motion (also html[data-motion=reduce]) with explicit animation:none and static frames.

ENGINE BEHAVIOUR (exactly 10.5)
- Observers: one IntersectionObserver with rootMargin -35% 0px -50% 0px; one ResizeObserver on main, rAF-debounced. Delegated pointerover (fine pointer) and focusin on .os-desktop, keydown Esc, visibilitychange. NO scroll listener.
- Layout and timing: rect reads only on activation, resize or tour step; writes batched in one rAF to CSS vars relative to the .os-desktop rect. 600ms dwell. Once per session per `pathname#key`, with last-wins and a 2.5s minimum gap.
- Movement: walk on the same roof, arc hop within 1.5 viewport heights (nested .gt-guide-x/.gt-guide-y transitions with the given easings, tilt and trail), drop-in when farther. Facing direction flips only the art wrapper.
- Speaking: bubble open, typing dots, wipe, talk mouth, auto-hide paused while hovered or focused.
- Spots: 350ms hover intent, 1.2s cooldown, keyboard focus-visible, selection box, may repeat.
- Greeting, idle line, blink and sit pose.
- Explicit mode: sprite click, explain event and tour steps. Update the live region with lang; set aria-expanded; Esc returns focus to the invoker.
- Tour: scrollIntoView with smooth or auto depending on reduced motion, then scrollend or a 900ms fallback. Focus moves to Next only. End tour. tourDone.
- Hide button: writeGuidePref(false). Turning off stops and cleans everything up; turning on re-boots.
- Compact mode: a fixed sprite above the dock using var(--dock-space), a hop plus the ! badge, no auto bubbles except a one-time 4s greeting, tap toggles, hidden while inputs are focused.
- NEVER: role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-hidden on the bubble, any network request, or touching content layout.

COPY: you own guide.ts after foundation. Polish the lines so they read well aloud. Keep them ≤140 chars in fa and ≤160 in en. Use the Persian brand form «گودین». Keep fa and en keys identical. Do not change the panel_* keys' meaning; panel-shell reads them.

brief:
